# Quick Note brand icon attribution

Sheetlog's Quick Note brand catalog combines small, purpose-built SVG marks, selected open icon paths, and two supplied source assets.

- Grab, Spotify, Shopee, Apple, iCloud, and Steam path data is sourced from [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons), released under CC0-1.0. Brand names and marks remain property of their respective owners.
- The OpenAI/ChatGPT path data is adapted from Font Awesome Free 7.3.1, Copyright Fonticons, Inc., and is used under CC BY 4.0. Source: [Font Awesome](https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/blob/7.x/svgs/brands/openai.svg).
- Jetts uses the supplied [Jetts source SVG](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/62b906070134352e8b2adb52/635a0751c3f0264fe0d0f378_Group%2038531.svg).
- RBSC uses the supplied [RBSC application icon](https://play-lh.googleusercontent.com/_PBmDbgqHYti2BIY7R1_rI4-it6_asaHx59Suojy01DPYmX7UX3K8NfeWApsXau59QVnC-iCoLtaZQ1n1UcENg).

The Jetts and RBSC source assets are visually normalized to the same icon box as the bundled marks. Their previous compact marks remain as offline or source-load fallbacks. The remaining compact marks are purpose-built for this interface and use the brands' recognizable official color families. They are not intended to replace full brand assets or identity guidelines.
